  2643	        normalized = normalized[:-2] + ":" + normalized[-2:]
  2644	    try:
  2645	        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(normalized)
  2646	    except ValueError:
  2647	        return None
  2648	    if parsed.tzinfo is None:
  2649	        parsed = parsed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
  2650	    return parsed.timestamp()
  2651	
  2652	
  2653	def assess_patchset_staleness(
  2654	    patchset: dict,
  2655	    *,
  2656	    now_ts: float | None = None,
  2657	    run_command: Callable[..., subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]] | None = None,
  2658	    cwd: Path | None = None,
  2659	    develop_ref: str = "origin/develop",
  2660	) -> PatchSetStaleness | None:
  2661	    """Return PS age/commit-distance staleness, or ``None`` when unavailable."""
  2662	    ps_parent = _patchset_parent_revision(patchset)
  2663	    upload_ts = _patchset_upload_ts(patchset)
  2664	    if not ps_parent or upload_ts is None:
  2665	        return None
  2666	
  2667	    current = now_ts if now_ts is not None else time.time()
  2668	    age_days = max(0.0, (current - upload_ts) / 86400.0)
  2669	    runner = run_command if run_command is not None else subprocess.run
  2670	    try:
  2671	        result = runner(
  2672	            ["git", "rev-list", "--count", f"{ps_parent}..{develop_ref}"],
  2673	            cwd=cwd,
  2674	            capture_output=True,
  2675	            text=True,
  2676	            timeout=15,
  2677	        )
  2678	    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
  2679	        return None
  2680	    if result.returncode != 0:
  2681	        return None
  2682	    try:
  2683	        commits_behind = int((result.stdout or "0").strip() or "0")
  2684	    except ValueError:
  2685	        return None
  2686	
  2687	    reasons: list[str] = []
  2688	    level = "fresh"
  2689	    if age_days > PS_STALENESS_ABSTAIN_DAYS:
  2690	        reasons.append(f"age_days>{PS_STALENESS_ABSTAIN_DAYS:g}")
  2691	        level = "abstain"
  2692	    if commits_behind > PS_STALENESS_ABSTAIN_COMMITS:
  2693	        reasons.append(f"commits_behind>{PS_STALENESS_ABSTAIN_COMMITS}")
  2694	        level = "abstain"
  2695	    if level != "abstain":
  2696	        if age_days > PS_STALENESS_WARN_DAYS:
  2697	            reasons.append(f"age_days>{PS_STALENESS_WARN_DAYS:g}")
  2698	            level = "warn"
  2699	        if commits_behind > PS_STALENESS_WARN_COMMITS:
  2700	            reasons.append(f"commits_behind>{PS_STALENESS_WARN_COMMITS}")
  2701	            level = "warn"
  2702	
  2703	    return PatchSetStaleness(
  2704	        age_days=age_days,
  2705	        commits_behind=commits_behind,
  2706	        ps_parent=ps_parent,
  2707	        level=level,
  2708	        reason=", ".join(reasons) if reasons else "fresh",
  2709	    )
  2710	
  2711	
  2712	def _format_ps_staleness_comment(
  2713	    *,
  2714	    marker: str,
  2715	    assessment: PatchSetStaleness,
  2716	    change_number: str | int | None = None,
  2717	) -> str:
  2718	    change = f" change={change_number}" if change_number else ""
  2719	    action = (
  2720	        "Abstaining until the patchset is manually rebased."
  2721	        if assessment.should_abstain
  2722	        else "Warning only; runner pickup may proceed."
  2723	    )
  2724	    return (
  2725	        f"[{marker}] {action}\n"
  2726	        f"- age_days={assessment.age_days:.1f}\n"
  2727	        f"- commits_behind={assessment.commits_behind}\n"
  2728	        f"- ps_parent={assessment.ps_parent[:12]}\n"
  2729	        f"- reason={assessment.reason}{change}\n"
  2730	        "Suggested action: rebase the Gerrit patchset manually onto "
  2731	        "`origin/develop`, then retry runner pickup."
  2732	    )

  2735	def _query_open_change_for_ticket_staleness(
  2736	    key: str,
  2737	    agent_class: str,
  2738	    instance_id: str | None = None,
  2739	) -> dict | None:
  2740	    try:
  2741	        gerrit_user, ssh_key = _gerrit_auth_for_instance(agent_class, instance_id)
  2742	    except ValueError:
  2743	        return None
  2744	    cmd = [
  2745	        "ssh", "-i", str(ssh_key), "-p", str(GERRIT_SSH_PORT),
  2746	        f"{gerrit_user}@{GERRIT_SSH_HOST}",
  2747	        "gerrit", "query", "--format=JSON", "--current-patch-set",
  2748	        "status:open", "branch:develop",
  2749	    ]
  2750	    try:
  2751	        result = BREAKERS["gerrit_ssh"].call(

  2753	        )

  2755	    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
  2756	        return None
  2757	
  2758	    for line in result.stdout.splitlines():
  2759	        try:
  2760	            change = json.loads(line)
  2761	        except json.JSONDecodeError:
  2762	            continue
  2763	        if change.get("type") == "stats":
  2764	            continue
  2765	        subject = str(change.get("subject") or "")

  2771	def pickup_staleness_check(
  2772	    client: DispatchClient,
  2773	    key: str,
  2774	    *,
  2775	    now_ts: float | None = None,
  2776	    worktree_path: Path | None = None,
  2777	) -> tuple[bool, str]:
  2778	    """Warn/abstain if an existing open PS for ``key`` is stale."""
  2779	    change = _query_open_change_for_ticket_staleness(key, client.agent_class)
  2780	    if change is None:
  2781	        return True, "ps staleness check skipped: no open Gerrit PS found"
  2782	    assessment = assess_patchset_staleness(
  2783	        change.get("currentPatchSet") or {},
  2784	        now_ts=now_ts,
  2785	        cwd=worktree_path,
  2786	    )
  2787	    if assessment is None or assessment.level == "fresh":
  2788	        return True, "ps staleness check passed"
  2789	
  2790	    marker = (
  2791	        "runner-ps-staleness-abstain"
  2792	        if assessment.should_abstain
  2793	        else "runner-ps-staleness-warn"
  2794	    )
  2795	    add_comment(
  2796	        client,
  2797	        key,
  2798	        _format_ps_staleness_comment(
  2799	            marker=marker,
  2800	            assessment=assessment,
  2801	            change_number=change.get("number") or change.get("_number"),
  2802	        ),
  2803	        idem_key=f"{marker}-{key}",
  2804	    )
  2805	    if assessment.should_abstain:
  2806	        return (
  2807	            False,
  2808	            "ps staleness exceeded: "
  2809	            f"age_days={assessment.age_days:.1f} "
  2810	            f"commits_behind={assessment.commits_behind}",
  2811	        )
  2812	    return (
  2813	        True,
  2814	        "ps staleness warning: "
  2815	        f"age_days={assessment.age_days:.1f} "
  2816	        f"commits_behind={assessment.commits_behind}",
  2817	    )

  2852	def _feature_dup_candidate_signal(

  2857	    """Prefer the ticket's open PS signal; fall back to planned file paths."""

  2859	    for signal in open_signals:

  2869	                areas=feature_dup_detector.areas_from_labels(snapshot.labels),
  2870	            )
  2871	    return feature_dup_detector.PatchSignal(
  2872	        ticket_key=snapshot.key,
  2873	        files_changed=frozenset(predict_target_files(snapshot, description=description)),
  2874	        description=description,

  2879	def _feature_dup_idem_key(left_key: str, right_key: str, reasons: Iterable[str]) -> str:
  2880	    pair = "-".join(sorted((left_key, right_key)))
  2881	    reason_key = "-".join(sorted(reasons))

  2885	def post_feature_dup_warnings(
  2886	    client: DispatchClient,
  2887	    snapshot: TicketSnapshot,
  2888	    *,
  2889	    description: str,
  2890	    open_signals: list[feature_dup_detector.PatchSignal] | None = None,
  2891	) -> list[feature_dup_detector.FeatureDupHit]:
  2892	    """Post non-blocking feature-dup warnings for the pickup candidate."""
  2893	
  2894	    if open_signals is None:
  2895	        open_signals = _open_bot_owned_patch_signals()
  2896	    candidate = _feature_dup_candidate_signal(snapshot, description, open_signals)
  2897	    hits = feature_dup_detector.detect_feature_duplicates(candidate, open_signals)
  2898	    for hit in hits:
  2899	        current_comment = feature_dup_detector.format_feature_dup_warning(
  2900	            candidate, hit
  2901	        )
  2902	        reverse_hit = feature_dup_detector.FeatureDupHit(
  2903	            other=candidate,
  2904	            reasons=hit.reasons,
  2905	            shared_symbols=hit.shared_symbols,
  2906	            file_jaccard=hit.file_jaccard,
  2907	            jira_similarity=hit.jira_similarity,
  2908	        )
  2909	        other_comment = feature_dup_detector.format_feature_dup_warning(
  2910	            hit.other, reverse_hit
  2911	        )
  2912	        idem = _feature_dup_idem_key(snapshot.key, hit.other.ticket_key, hit.reasons)
  2913	        add_comment(client, snapshot.key, current_comment, idem_key=f"{idem}-current")
  2914	        add_comment(client, hit.other.ticket_key, other_comment, idem_key=f"{idem}-other")
  2915	    return hits

  2918	def _paths_overlap(targets: set[str], in_flight: set[str]) -> set[str]:
  2919	    import fnmatch
  2920	
  2921	    overlaps: set[str] = set()
  2922	    for target in targets:
  2923	        for path in in_flight:
  2924	            if target == path or fnmatch.fnmatch(path, target) or fnmatch.fnmatch(target, path):
  2925	                overlaps.add(path)
  2926	    return overlaps

  2932	        if isinstance(label, str) and label.startswith("class:"):
  2933	            return label.split(":", 1)[1]
  2934	    return "subscription-codex"

  2937	def _check_active_claim_hot_overlap(
  2938	    snapshot: TicketSnapshot,
  2939	    hot_in_target: set[str],
  2940	) -> tuple[bool, str]:
  2941	    """Block hot-file pickup when another claimed ticket declares same path."""
  2942	    client = make_client(_agent_class_from_snapshot(snapshot), _instance_id_from_env())
  2943	    jql = (
  2944	        f'project = "{client.project_key}" '
  2945	        f'AND labels ~ "{CLAIM_LABEL_PREFIX}*" '
  2946	        f'AND key != "{snapshot.key}"'
  2947	    )
  2948	    resp = _request(client, "POST", "/search/jql", {
  2949	        "jql": jql,
  2950	        "fields": ["labels"],
  2951	        "maxResults": 50,
  2952	    })
  2953	    for issue in resp.get("issues", []):
  2954	        key = issue.get("key", "?")
  2955	        labels = ((issue.get("fields") or {}).get("labels")) or []
  2956	        if not any(isinstance(label, str) and label.startswith(CLAIM_LABEL_PREFIX) for label in labels):
  2957	            continue
  2958	        description = fetch_description(client, key)
  2959	        overlap = _paths_overlap(hot_in_target, parse_files_section(description))
  2960	        if not overlap:
  2961	            continue
  2962	        first = sorted(overlap)[0]
  2963	        return (
  2964	            False,
  2965	            (
  2966	                f"hot-file claim collision: {first} already claimed by {key}; "
  2967	                f"[runner-hot-file-mutex] pre-PS claim-level mutex blocked pickup"
  2968	            ),
  2969	        )
  2970	    return True, "no active hot-file claim collision"

  2973	def migration_scope_globs(labels: Iterable[str]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
  2974	    """Extract ``migration:scope=<glob>`` labels from a JIRA label list."""
  2975	    scopes: list[str] = []
  2976	    for label in labels:
  2977	        if label.startswith(MIGRATION_SCOPE_PREFIX):
  2978	            scope = label[len(MIGRATION_SCOPE_PREFIX):].strip()
  2979	            if scope:
  2980	                scopes.append(scope)
  2981	    return tuple(scopes)

  3000	    migrations: list[MigrationFreeze] = []

  3009	def migration_freeze_check(
  3010	    client: DispatchClient,
  3011	    snapshot: TicketSnapshot,
  3012	    description: str | None = None,

  3014	    """Gate pickup while a META migration freezes overlapping paths."""

  3016	    active = find_active_migrations(client, exclude_key=snapshot.key)
  3017	    for migration in active:
  3018	        overlap = _paths_overlap(target_paths, set(migration.scope_globs))
  3019	        if not overlap:
  3020	            continue
  3021	        first = sorted(overlap)[0]
  3022	        if MIGRATION_OVERRIDE_LABEL in set(getattr(snapshot, "labels", ())):
  3023	            add_comment(

  3028	                    f"{migration.key} freeze for {first}."
  3029	                ),
  3030	                idem_key=f"migration-override-{snapshot.key}-{migration.key}",
  3031	            )
  3032	            return True, f"migration override: {migration.key} overlaps {first}"
  3033	        add_comment(
  3034	            client,
  3035	            snapshot.key,
  3036	            f"[runner-migration-freeze] paused — waiting on {migration.key} migration to complete",
  3037	            idem_key=f"migration-freeze-{snapshot.key}-{migration.key}",
  3038	        )
  3039	        return False, f"migration freeze: {migration.key} overlaps {first}"
  3040	    return True, "no active migration freeze"

  3043	def file_mutex_check(
  3044	    snapshot: TicketSnapshot,
  3045	    description: str | None = None,
  3046	) -> tuple[bool, str]:
  3047	    """Return whether ``snapshot`` can be picked up without file collision.
  3048	
  3049	    OP-800: extended to detect overlap with currently-open Gerrit PSes
  3050	    (Pattern 12 cure 3 — runtime layer). On collision the reason cites the
  3051	    blocker's Gerrit change number, points at the Pattern 12 cookbook entry,
  3052	    and lists the three operator resolution paths. The
  3053	    ``runner-mutex-override:file-overlap`` label on the candidate ticket
  3054	    bypasses the gate for cases where the operator has an explicit
  3055	    hand-merge plan.
  3056	    """
  3057	    target = predict_target_files(snapshot, description=description)
  3058	    if not target:
  3059	        return True, "no prediction available - mutex check skipped"
  3060	
  3061	    try:
  3062	        in_flight_owners = _open_bot_owned_file_owners()
  3063	    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as exc:
  3064	        return True, f"gerrit query failed - mutex check skipped: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
  3065	
  3066	    overlap = _paths_overlap(target, set(in_flight_owners))
  3067	    if not overlap:
  3068	        hot_in_target = target & HOT_FILES
  3069	        if hot_in_target:
  3070	            try:
  3071	                ok, reason = _check_active_claim_hot_overlap(snapshot, hot_in_target)
  3072	            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - hot-file JIRA probe fails open
  3073	                log.warning(
  3074	                    "hot-file claim mutex query failed for %s: %s: %s",
  3075	                    snapshot.key,
  3076	                    type(exc).__name__,
  3077	                    exc,
  3078	                )
  3079	                return (
  3080	                    True,
  3081	                    "no open-PS collision; hot-file claim query failed - "
  3082	                    f"pre-PS mutex skipped: {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}",
  3083	                )
  3084	            if not ok:
  3085	                return False, reason
  3086	        return True, "no collision"
  3087	
  3088	    first_path = sorted(overlap)[0]
  3089	    owner = in_flight_owners[first_path][0]
  3090	
  3091	    if FILE_OVERLAP_OVERRIDE_LABEL in set(getattr(snapshot, "labels", ())):
  3092	        hot_in_target = target & HOT_FILES
  3093	        if hot_in_target:
  3094	            try:
  3095	                ok, reason = _check_active_claim_hot_overlap(snapshot, hot_in_target)
  3096	            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - hot-file JIRA probe fails open
  3097	                log.warning(
  3098	                    "hot-file claim mutex query failed for %s: %s: %s",
  3099	                    snapshot.key,
  3100	                    type(exc).__name__,
  3101	                    exc,
  3102	                )
  3103	                ok = True
  3104	            if not ok:
  3105	                return False, reason
  3106	        return (
  3107	            True,
  3108	            f"file-overlap override: {FILE_OVERLAP_OVERRIDE_LABEL} bypassed "
  3109	            f"PS #{owner.change_number} on {first_path} (operator hand-merge plan)",
  3110	        )
  3111	
  3112	    return (
  3113	        False,
  3114	        (
  3115	            f"file collision: {first_path} already in open PS #{owner.change_number} "
  3116	            f"(owner: {owner.owner})\n"
  3117	            f"Pattern 12 cure 3 ({PATTERN_12_COOKBOOK_LINK}). Resolution: "
  3118	            f"(a) merge PS #{owner.change_number} first then this ticket rebases, "
  3119	            f"(b) rebase the conflicting PS onto the merged base, or "
  3120	            f"(c) re-scope this ticket to a non-overlapping path set per Pattern 12 cure 1. "
  3121	            f"Override: add label `{FILE_OVERLAP_OVERRIDE_LABEL}` for an explicit hand-merge plan."
  3122	        ),
  3123	    )

Fix: Add an early `resolve_routed_repo(labels)` gate before `sync_to_gerrit_develop`; if any `repo:*` label exists and is unresolved, revert/abstain before worktree prep.

2. BLOCKER — Claims 1/3 broken: the normal push path cannot currently target the routed project.
EVIDENCE: `push_to_gerrit_for_review()` supports `project_key` at `backend/agents/jira_dispatch.py:1699-1706`, but the runner calls it without `tenant_id` or `project_key` at `auto-runner-jira.py:3434-3436`. With no project key, resolver defaults at `backend/agents/jira_dispatch.py:1732-1736`.
INFERENCE: Even if a runner cloned the right repo, the current runner call would still select the default delivery path unless the call site is changed.
Fix: Thread a routed repo descriptor through sync, CLI, and push; call `push_to_gerrit_for_review(..., tenant_id=..., project_key=...)` or a repo-name based delivery API.

3. BLOCKER — Claims 1/3 broken: baseline fetch is hardcoded to Productizer Gerrit.
EVIDENCE: `GERRIT_PROJECT_PATH = "omnisight/OmniSight-Productizer"` at `backend/agents/jira_dispatch.py:499-503`; `_gerrit_ssh_url()` always returns that project at `backend/agents/jira_dispatch.py:660-665`; `sync_to_gerrit_develop()` fetches from `_gerrit_ssh_url(...)` at `backend/agents/jira_dispatch.py:1194-1199`.
EVIDENCE: The tenant-push section explicitly says the develop-baseline fetch is “a separate concern” and “intentionally left untouched” at `backend/agents/jira_dispatch.py:695-698`.
Fix: Generalize fetch URL/project along with push. Do not reuse `sync_to_gerrit_develop()` for routed repos until it accepts `repo_url`, `ref`, and auth identity.

4. MAJOR — Claim 1 overstated: camviewpro lane is not a generic repo-routing lane.
EVIDENCE: It detects only `target:camviewpro` at `auto-runner-jira.py:1763-1765`; extracts `camviewpro-*` labels at `auto-runner-jira.py:1768-1809`; hardcodes `git_account_ref="camviewpro-ro"` at `auto-runner-jira.py:1823-1834`; records `camviewpro-pr:*` at `auto-runner-jira.py:1855`.
EVIDENCE: `contribution_runner.py` imports `open_contribution_pr` at `backend/agents/contribution_runner.py:17` and always opens a GitHub PR at `backend/agents/contribution_runner.py:181-193`, with camviewpro body text at `backend/agents/contribution_runner.py:187-190`.
Fix: Extract source clone/branch/implement from delivery. Add separate `GerritReviewDelivery` and remove camviewpro naming from generic paths/tests.

5. MAJOR — Claim 3 broken: the existing delivery resolver is fail-open to Productizer for malformed config.
EVIDENCE: Invalid `delivery_targets` JSON is ignored and uses defaults at `backend/agents/delivery_target.py:95-113`; a non-dict or missing `repo_url` returns the OmniSight default at `backend/agents/delivery_target.py:131-140`.
INFERENCE: This is acceptable for “no project_key” back-compat, but unsafe for an explicit `repo:conference-appliance` label.
Fix: Split APIs: `resolve_default_delivery_target(None)` may fall back; `resolve_required_routed_repo("conference-appliance")` must raise on missing, malformed, or incomplete config.

6. MAJOR — Claim 5 side-effect: shared Gerrit gates are not project-scoped.
EVIDENCE: Backpressure counts open changes by owner only, no `project:` filter, at `backend/agents/jira_dispatch.py:560-568`. File-mutex scans all open Gerrit changes at `backend/agents/jira_dispatch.py:2567-2588`. Staleness scans `status:open branch:develop`, no project filter, at `backend/agents/jira_dispatch.py:2735-2749`.
INFERENCE: Conference-appliance changes can pause Productizer runners, create false file collisions on same relative paths, or match the wrong open patch for a ticket key.
Fix: Include Gerrit project in backpressure, mutex, staleness, duplicate detection, and already-merged queries. Key by `(repo/project, ticket)`.

7. MAJOR — Claim 5 tenant binding is underspecified and can leak Productizer context.
EVIDENCE: Label-less tickets default to `omnisight-self` at `backend/agents/runner_tenant.py:66-85`; self tenant keeps the legacy workspace at `backend/agents/runner_tenant.py:153-166`; prompt building includes internal OmniSight context only for `omnisight-self` per `auto-runner-jira.py:1216-1264`.
INFERENCE: A conference ticket with only `repo:conference-appliance` will still bind `omnisight-self`, so runner prompt/context behavior remains Productizer-internal unless repo routing explicitly overrides tenant/context.
Fix: Decide whether `conference-appliance` is same tenant but different repo, or its own tenant. Encode that in routed repo config and prompt/context selection.

8. MAJOR — Claim 4 unverified: the checked-in Case 5 doc does not contain the 21 ticket bodies.
EVIDENCE: The doc has phase bullets and says each leaf should be “4-AC” at `docs/architecture/2026-06-14-case5-conferencing-device-epic-design.md:142-153`, but no OP-2170..2189 bodies, no per-ticket scope-anchor/MUST-NOT sections, and no dependency DAG table. PRE-1 is described only as a prerequisite at `docs/architecture/2026-06-14-case5-conferencing-device-epic-design.md:139-140`.
INFERENCE: The “21 tickets are sound” claim cannot be audited from this repository state.
Fix: Commit the exact JIRA filing specs or an export containing every OP-2170..2189 description, labels, blockers, mutexes, ACs, and HOLD state.

9. MAJOR — Claim 4 weak gate: “Exercised on RK3588” is asserted, not operationalized.
EVIDENCE: The design says every ticket is exercised via `atkctl`/`atklink` at `docs/architecture/2026-06-14-case5-conferencing-device-epic-design.md:148-153`, while runner SOP requires each runtime AC to have a machine `verify:` block at `docs/operations/runner-operations-sop.md:71-78`.
INFERENCE: Without per-ticket `verify:` commands and operator/HIL split, a runner can fake the exercised gate with local build/test output.
Fix: For every hardware AC, require `verify:` command, attached serial/log artifact, and explicit “operator-HIL required” where physical observation is needed.

10. MINOR — Claim 5 partly true but not auditable enough: shared state lacks repo dimension.
EVIDENCE: runner metrics record agent, instance, ticket, type, tier, area, model only at `backend/agents/runner_metrics_recorder.py:211-227`. Idempotency DB is per bot/instance path, not repo, at `backend/agents/idempotency.py:21-39`. Claim labels are `claim:{instance}:{token}` on JIRA tickets at `backend/agents/jira_dispatch.py:3148-3158`.
INFERENCE: JIRA ticket keys probably prevent direct collisions, but fleet observability and dedupe cannot distinguish Productizer vs conference work.
Fix: Add `repo_name` / `gerrit_project` to metrics, claim `external_refs`, idempotency key prefixes for routed repo mutations, and operator dashboards.
